*   `?g A14`: Main Concept is Food/Eating/Edible.
    *   `+ F11 x8` (in group g): A count of 8 of something related to "One/Unit/Number". So, 8 units of food.
    *   `!y Yellow | H11`: Sub-concept (Yellow) is thin/fine/narrow. (Yellow + Thin/Narrow).
    *   `!r E3 | E4`: Sub-concept (Red) is Fire/Burn/Cooking and Air/Wind/Blowing. (Cooking + Air/Blowing).
    *   `!k White | G10`: Sub-concept (Black) is Big/High. (White + Big/High). *Wait, the notation says `!k White + G10`. `!k` is a Black marker. `White` is a color swatch. `G10` is Big/High.* So: Black sub-concept, color White, icon G10 (Big/High).

    *   `?g A14` (Food) + `8` units.
    *   `!y Yellow` + `H11` (Thin/Narrow) -> Thin yellow things? (Noodles, spaghetti, fries - though fries aren't thin/narrow in the context of H11, usually H11 is more like string/hair/fine line).
    *   `!r E3` (Fire/Cooking) + `E4` (Air/Wind/Blowing).
    *   `!k White` + `G10` (Big/High).

    *   Step 1: 8 things, food.
    *   Step 2: Yellow, thin/narrow.
    *   Step 3: Cooking (Fire) + Air/Wind/Blowing.
    *   Step 4: White, Big/High.
